title: Jarring Miso Portuguese Burrata Fondue
description: A pungent blend of miso-marinated burrata, crispy chorizo, and comforting crusty bread, all served in a warm fondue pot.

ingredients.name: Burrata cheese
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a kosher-friendly burrata brand.

instructions: Combine the miso paste, garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl to make the marinade.
Marinate the sliced chorizo in the miso paste mixture for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Cut the burrata cheese into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
Place the marinated chorizo in the fondue pot and set over low heat to warm.
Add the burrata cheese balls to the fondue pot and stir gently to combine with the chorizo.
Add the cubed bread to the fondue pot and stir gently to combine with the cheese and chorizo.
Cook the fondue for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
Season the fondue with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the fondue hot, garnished with chopped parsley and olives.
Offer the red pepper flakes on the side for guests to add to their fondue for extra heat.
